summary: Obfuscated bulk-mail / mailbox-attack toolkit acting on operator-chosen targets
details: monogrok ships a heavily obfuscated (javascript-obfuscator) offensive toolkit whose entire codebase — cmds/*, func/**, utils/* — is scoped to attacking external targets the operator supplies: bulk SMTP mass-mailing with proxy/SOCKS rotation and rate limiting, attachment spoofing (config includes.exe/.msi in zip_file_paths and a spoof_attachment_extension flag), HTML/QR/image/EPUB payload generation, Shodan-driven SMTP/OWA target discovery, IMAP/POP3/EWS/OWA mailbox harvesting, redirect chains, and SendGrid/AWS SES abuse modules. package.json declares main/bin at oibWljdTg.js with no preinstall/install/postinstall/prepare lifecycle scripts. The tool operates on operator-supplied targets and operator-supplied credentials; there is no traced code path that reads the installer's own secrets (~/.aws, ~/.ssh, ~/.npmrc, keychain, browser stores), scrapes environment variables, drops persistence on the installer, or opens a backdoor into the installer's host. The Discord webhook is a result sink for the operator's own campaign output, not an installer-exfil channel. Homepage mntmc.rip and the github:oonlyjs/node-ews dependency are consistent with offensive-tooling distribution rather than a supply-chain trojan.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
